notes.title: New game "Out of Colors"
notes.content:
Hi guys,
first of all thank you very much for testing and playing our first VR experience "Marius". With bringing animated and interactive characters to VR we had to thrill a thick board. As we are a very small now self funded studio we had to pause the development of "Marius" since creating character animation for VR is a complex and expensive thing. Nevertheless we think this is definitely a big part of the future of VR experiences.

We now have to leave Marius at his library for some time and focus on other projects that we can build without having to pull in so many people. 

That's why we wanted to show you guys our new VR game "Out Of Colors". It is a VR-only multiplayer racer experience with remote control cars taking place in a teenager’s room from the nineties. More info at outofcolors.com
If you would like to play it as one of the first you can leave your email at our website granolastudios.com at the very end / early access. We will send 50 free coupons out to you guys. First come first serve.

Have a good one,
Dominik
